messages:
Maria: quick sync — Vega corp dedicated capacity activation is set for tomorrow morning. final checklist: quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short load test window. who can own each? :calendar:
Sam: I can take quota confirmation. need to know requested GPU types and min/max units. Rob (Vega): they requested 8x A100s initially but asked if we can start with 4 and autoscale up. cost and SLAs are a concern for them.
Devon: FYI our autoscale policy templates are in /opt/playbooks/autoscale-templates. i'd recommend a conservative min=2, target-util=65%, max=8 for the first 48h. can post a quick json here.
Devon: ```json
{"policy_name":"vega-activation-1","min_nodes":2,"max_nodes":8,"scale_out_threshold":0.65,"cooldown_secs":300}
```
Alisha: i'll run the short smoke load tests and check latency p95. can we agree on a 20-minute window at 09:30 UTC? i'll need a test endpoint and an api-key.
Maria: 09:30 UTC works. Sam — can you confirm quota and provide test creds?
Sam: confirmed quotas: 4 reserved GPUs initially approved (billing in trial), request form flagged for ramp to 8 if autoscale hits >75% for >15m. uploading quota snapshot now. cc @deploy-bot to provision test creds.
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: provision-temp-key user=vega-test duration=2h -> key id vk-9f3b
Rob (Vega): perfect. can we also have a lower min so we don't burn cost overnight? 2 min is fine.
Devon: agreed, min=2. also enabling prefix cache and KV warming on first activation to avoid cold-start token spikes. note: cache warming will add ~2m before steady state.
Alisha: load test plan (short): 5m ramp, 10m steady at 60 req/s, 5m ramp down. will capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, token/sec, and cost estimate. command i'll run: `./bin/loadgen --target https://vega.test/api/generate --qps 60 --duration 1200 --key vk-9f3b`
Maria: add a small canary route: route->vega-dedicated-canary that routes 5% of internal prod traffic during activation. we will watch traces in console.
Sam: I added the canary route config to the deployment PR. snippet: ```yaml
routes:
 - name: vega-dedicated-canary
   traffic: 0.05
   model: redwood/llama-2-13b
```
Devon: i'll monitor autoscale events and set alerts for sustained scale >4 for 10m. If we hit >6 nodes automatically, we'll ramp down non-critical background jobs.
Rob (Vega): do you capture per-account cost in near real-time? we want to watch burn.
Maria: console has token-level cost breakdown, i'll set a dashboard and share link. also tagging billing alerts to Rob.
Alisha: post-test checklist: upload eval snippets, sample responses, and any regressions. Also need a quick postmortem if errors >0.5%.
Sam: quota and creds handled. PR merged. 
Devon: deploy plan: 09:10 UTC provision reserved pool, 09:25 enable autoscale policy, 09:30 start cache warm, 09:32 start canary, 09:40 start load test, 10:10 end tests and debrief.
Maria: action items: Sam -> quota + creds (done), Devon -> enable autoscale + monitor, Alisha -> run test + upload artifacts, Rob -> confirm internal stakeholders will watch dashboard. I'll join ops call at 09:00 UTC.
Rob (Vega): i'll be on call. thanks team :thumbsup:
Maria: any last blockers?
Sam: none from infra.
Devon: one note — if prefix cache hits <40% during canary we should abort and rollback. logging alert created.
Alisha: i'll post logs and a short summary in this thread immediately after.
Maria: great — see you all tomorrow, will post the console link once dashboard is ready. :rocket:
